data.name: The Lark
data.entry: Tucked away in Kensington, Brooklyn, The Lark is a small but cozy coffee shop that comfortably fits around 20 people. In the early morning, it/’s a calm and peaceful spot, ideal for easing into the day, though it starts to fill up around 9 or 10 a.m. as the neighborhood crowd rolls in. There/’s a good balance of indoor seating, along with a few outdoor options for those who prefer fresh air. I ordered the glazed croissant with a chocolate filling. While the icing was a bit too sweet for my taste (I usually drink my coffee black, no sugar), the croissant itself was wonderfully flaky and fresh. The shop also offers free Wi-Fi and multiple outlets, making it a great place to settle in and get some work done. I/’m definitely looking forward to returning to try some of their less sweet pastries. Until next time—enjoy!
